name: 尹秦清
objective:
本課程主要在介紹領導與組織管理的理論與實務。課程目的有四個：(1) 了解組織領導與管理的內涵；(2) 討論領導與組織管理的理論與實證發現之間的差異；(3) 對實務界人士提供具體建議；(4) 將領導與管理的技巧應用到生活面。
This course focuses on the theory and practice of leadership and management in organization. Its purpose is threefold: (1) To gain an understanding of what the content of organizational leadership and management is; (2) to effectively combine the basic concepts of leadership and organization management and empirical findings and discuss the discrepancies and implications; (3) to discuss practical implications for business management and (4) to apply the basic ideas of leadership and management in daily life.
schedule:
1. 企業管理內涵 / 分析工具
2. 管理與決策
3. 管理者與溝通
4. 個案討論

出席：50%
課堂討論與報告: 50%
materials: 參考書籍：洪偉典 譯，管理學，第 14 版，華泰文化，2019 年 9 月
consultation: 1. 課程上課時間，同學有問題可以直接詢問 2. 可以透過 e-mail 與老師約時間討論 (yhvica@ntut.edu.tw)

name: 陳育威
objective:
本課程聚焦於 ** 領導力與組織管理 ** 的核心理論與實務應用，涵蓋領導風格與自我覺察、組織結構與文化、溝通與決策機制、團隊建立與績效管理，以及變革與衝突管理等主題。透過案例分析、情境討論與實務演練，引導學員理解如何在不同組織情境中有效領導成員、整合資源、提升組織效能，並培養具備策略思維與人本關懷的現代領導者。
This course focuses on the core theories and practical applications of **Leadership and Organizational Management**. It covers leadership styles and self-awareness, organizational structure and culture, communication and decision-making, team building and performance management, as well as change and conflict management. Through case studies, scenario-based discussions, and practical exercises, participants will develop the ability to lead effectively in diverse organizational contexts, integrate resources, enhance organizational performance, and cultivate strategic, people-centered leadership capabilities.
schedule:
1. 領導力基礎
2. 組織管理與團隊領導
3. 變革、策略與實務應用

name: 蔡佩芳
objective:
本課程主要在介紹高階管理的理論與實務。將透過學校老師與企業高階管理者與學生一起探討當前管理重要議題。本課程以哈佛個案教學方法進行，在每個個案討論當中，同時由行銷管理、財務管理、科技管理、生產管理領域老師教授。可以讓學生在學管理工功能之外，還可以學習這些管理功能的整合，學期末並有分組個案競賽，促進團隊互動與學習。
This course focuses on the introduction and discussion of theories and practices of contemporary management topics. Besides university professors, renowned top manager will be invited to share the best practice experiences of the workplace in the lecture. The Integrated Management Case Studies would be taught by case methods from Havard Business School’s cases. Every case will be taught from Marketing, Financing, Technology Management, and Operation Management areas faculty. This course focus on the integration of management functions. The case contest will be hold on the final week to encourage team building and learning.
schedule:
創新與創業與顧客關係管理
領導與組織管理個案分析 哈佛個案 [HBS Case] LEGO (9 - 616- C03 中文版)
[遠距教學] 創新與創業 -  創造顧客價值
[遠距教學] 領導與組織管理 - 領導決策與倫理
